claim_boundary: Repository-local contracts and development tests are not a G1 certificate. Fake inference, WSL telemetry, nominal capacity, and source inspection do not substitute for real signed models, both physical A1 boards, security/manual/performance evidence, or the specified large-model experiment.

items.subject: policy-dag-platform-model-pack-and-local-gateway-contracts

items.subject: host-and-gpu-telemetry-adapter
items.observations: Three deterministic adapter tests passed, followed by a read-only adapter smoke against WSL host RAM and the observed RTX 3050. No model was loaded, so this does not prove allocation enforcement, inference, isolation, performance, recovery, or a service class.

closure_rule: G1 may be marked passed only when G0 dependencies are resolved and every G1 exit criterion has retained current-revision evidence on the required real environments.
